assessment: Both variants matched all 12 expected selections. No accuracy increase was observed. The candidate reported eight unique discovery files versus five for the baseline across this mixed batch; no reading-cost reduction is claimed. This is one selection rehearsal per variant, not independent task execution per case or a controlled effectiveness/token study. Host activation and actual task completion remain untested.
